title: The text model lineup shifted
summary:
The text API’s model lineup was reshaped while community projects and API examples became easier to find and use.

Model routing and the catalog changed throughout the week. By April 19, `openai` pointed to GPT-4.1 nano and `openai-large` to GPT-4.1 mini. `openai-reasoning` returned with text and image input, `llama-vision` returned, and `gemini` joined with Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview. DeepSeek routing was also refactored, and several older model IDs were removed.

New listings ranged from Frame’s voice-to-image wearable app and MCPollinations’ assistant-friendly server to image tools, a simulator, a Discord bot, and OkeyAI’s work with African languages and cultural contexts. The directory also corrected MCPollinations’ author credit and moved VibeCoder into Tools & Interfaces. These were listings and directory edits, not claims that the projects were built this week.

Referral processing began considering responses without Markdown formatting and gained more affiliate matches, while links and the fallback Ko-fi prompt appeared less often. Translation now checks the full content’s language, helping leave English ad copy alone.

The website’s Python image example now shows how to set a model, dimensions, and seed before generating. The text-to-speech POST example puts `voice` and `format` inside an `audio` object and requests both text and audio modalities.
